summary: Go 1.27.4 and 1.26.11, released 10 November 2026, include 12 security fixes in cgo, the go command, the compiler, the linker, and net/http. The eMudhra trust filter stays on the 1.27.3 and 1.26.10 lines.
remediation: Install Go 1.27.4 or, on the 1.26 line, Go 1.26.11, and rebuild programs built with the older toolchain.
